name: Context7
summary: Up-to-date, version-specific documentation and code examples for software libraries, served to coding agents through a REST API, a hosted MCP server and a CLI. Search and docs calls answer without any account at a low rate limit.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-08: library search, documentation context and the MCP initialize handshake all answer 200 with no key. A key (free account) raises the rate limit and unlocks adding libraries and private repositories.
